description: This file implements the USBDeviceImplementation class, which manages USB device detection, information retrieval, driver binding/unbinding, and event dispatching using libusb. It handles device hotplug events, retrieves device descriptors, serial numbers, and device paths, and manages notification callbacks for device events.

classes.name: USBDeviceImplementation
classes.description: Implements USB device management including detection, info retrieval, driver control, and event notification.

methods.name: USBDeviceImplementation
methods.description: Constructor initializing the USB device management, setting up libusb, and registering hotplug callbacks.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Singleton accessor and setter for the USBDeviceImplementation instance.

methods.name: ~USBDeviceImplementation
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up libusb resources and threads.

methods.name: libUSBInit
methods.description: Initializes libusb context, registers hotplug callbacks, and starts event handling thread.

methods.name: libUSBClose
methods.description: Cleans up libusb resources, deregisters callbacks, and stops event thread.

methods.name: libUSBEventsHandlingThread
methods.description: Thread function to handle libusb events.

methods.name: libUSBHotPlugCallbackDeviceAttached
methods.description: Callback invoked when a USB device is attached; retrieves device info and dispatches event.

methods.name: libUSBHotPlugCallbackDeviceDetached
methods.description: Callback invoked when a USB device is detached; retrieves device info and dispatches event.

methods.name: getDeviceSerialNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the serial number of a USB device via sysfs.

methods.name: getDevicePathFromDevice
methods.description: Determines the device path for a USB device by matching serial number and device info.

methods.name: getUSBDescriptorValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string descriptor from a device handle given a language ID and index.

methods.name: getUSBExtInfoStructFromDeviceDescriptor
methods.description: Retrieves extended device info including manufacturer, product, and serial number strings.

methods.name: getUSBDeviceInfoStructFromDeviceDescriptor
methods.description: Fills a USBDeviceInfo structure with details from device descriptor and configuration.

methods.name: getUSBDevicClassFromInterfaceDescriptor
methods.description: Determines device class and subclass from interface descriptors.

methods.name: getUSBDeviceStructFromDeviceDescriptor
methods.description: Populates a USBDevice structure with basic device info from device descriptor.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for device events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches a device event to registered notifications.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Invokes callback methods for device plugged in/out events.

methods.name: GetDeviceList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of connected USB devices.

methods.name: GetDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves detailed info for a specific device by device name.

methods.name: BindDriver
methods.description: Binds a driver to a device specified by device name.

methods.name: UnbindDriver
methods.description: Unbinds a driver from a device specified by device name.
